title: Ordering music and borrowing arrangements from the Vidal band
summary: He explains ordering stock arrangements and learning numbers from the Vidal band to bring home to his Parks band.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: We used to play with me too, that's Albany. You were talking about the music. Where did you order this music? From what companies?

Well sometimes we used to order from Jerome Remick. Yeah. And sometimes from two or three different companies. I wish I could think of the name. But you know as the people would ask for the number, we'd get them. And then sometimes they'd get them for me, you see. I didn't have to get them.
Well what kind of music did you use here with your Parks band? Marches, things of this kind?

Well I tell you, after we stopped playing, you understand, like that, we used to use all kinds of music. We didn't use hardly any marches because it was always a dance music we used to play, you see. And like I tell you, we didn't have no music at all. We just had to pick it up the best way we could. And believe me, we used to pick it up. Yes, we used to pick it up. How would you pick it up? Anywhere we'd hear a song. You know what I used to do? I used to leave here like on a Monday or Tuesday, and I'd go over there and play with the Vidal. You heard it of the Vidal band. I'd play with the Vidal sometimes three and four nights. And then I'd play with the Vidal. And every number that the Vidal played, I'd come right here and play with my little band. You'd bring the whole thing back?
You'd bring the whole thing back?

I'd bring the whole thing back, trombone, bass, everything. Second part of the cornet, we always call that cornet, don't you? Second cornet part, trombone part, bass part, baritone part, I'd give them all that part. And believe me, somehow or rather I didn't know, but the people looked like they were elated over it. They used to give the band all the work they wanted.
Did any of the bands consider any of these works their special possessions, their special ownings, and resent your coming in or anyone else borrowing it from them?

Well not at all, because like I said, there's only one band that I used to go and catch a few numbers with that was Vidal. And they used to like for me to play with them, you see? So therefore that kept my band going all the time. Whoa. Whoa. Whoa.
